descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-24 Deletions · S06 Hospital, after processing: delete → the existing note and summary unchanged; Regenerate and a second Save Note leave the deleted items out

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U2 A medication row, a task or an Important Point deleted after processing leaves the existing summary and note unchanged until the physician regenerates. (UAT TC-24) — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress
  • U1 A medication row, a task or an Important Point deleted before processing is not included in the summary (the pre-round Save Note result) or in the generated note. (UAT TC-24) — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress
  • U10 Every TC-24 rule holds in both Hospital and Nursing Home, including deleting a Nursing Home resident. (UAT 3.3; UAT TC-24)

Test design technique: Decision table (decision-table) — List the combinations of several conditions and check each one, to see that the result follows the rule.

Given A Hospital patient already processed: a generated note (status note-ready) that names the items about to be deleted, a background that names apixaban, a saved pre-round text and encounter notes

When Snapshot the note and the summary; delete the named rows (two active, one held, one stopped), the task and the point; snapshot the note and the summary again; press Regenerate Note; then press Save Note again without changing the text

Then Cells: item kind (active / held / stopped row, task, Important Point) × timing. Before processing: absent (S01). After processing, no regenerate: the note and the background / course read exactly as before. After processing + Regenerate: the new note leaves out metoprolol, metformin, tramadol, the goals-of-care call and the heel ulcer, and carries today's e …

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): U2: cp3 must equal cp1 in the note body and cp4 must equal cp2 in the background and course sections (sameAs, runnerGaps 5); until sameAs exists the seeded sentences must still be there (mustContain), which catches a removed sentence but not a reworded one. …

Where it ran: dev; test method AGENT · Browser agent; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (automated)

S06 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-24.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build 25acd72 (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-15T14:04:39Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: AGENT · Browser agent; secondary: AICHECK · AI output check — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on dev; Source: dev.
